title: OL-20261117-4: SPINOFF zone transfer link on 2026-11-20
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** date >= 2026-11-20
**Done check:** grep:deploy/transfer/plan.json::ultrastable-spinoffs
**Status:** open

When the Registrar confirmations open on 2026-11-20, the ultrastable.app zone, the spinoffs Worker and its D1 move to the ultrastable account. A scheduled loop must publish the single confirm link (CONNECT-LINK-1) in needs-you.json with the default (stay in quniverse) in effect.
